notes: Owner's decision 2026-10-11 (docs/decisions/2026-10-11-new-rules-after-10.md): rules added after 1.0 stay off until `<StyleBroPreset>` names a version that includes them (`1.1`, or `latest`), like .NET's AnalysisLevel. Each rule records the version it was added in, the package targets pick the preset globalconfig for that version, and init/migrate write the current version. Open questions: what `recommended` (today's value) maps to, and how the IDE and `dotnet format` see the chosen preset (both read the globalconfig the targets add as EditorConfigFiles).
